prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: rear-end collision. Injury: wrist fracture. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1364; do not mention it.)
text:
Our client, [CLIENT_NAME], was stopped at a red light when your insured's vehicle struck the rear of her car at speed. The impact was forceful, and the police report documents the collision and the resulting damage to our client's vehicle. Your insured has acknowledged responsibility for the crash, and liability is not reasonably in dispute.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a fracture of the wrist. She was transported from the scene for evaluation and has since required immobilization, follow-up orthopedic care, and physical therapy. Her treating physicians have documented the injury and its expected course of recovery. She has lost time from work and continues to experience pain, reduced grip strength, and limitations in her daily activities.

The medical records, billing statements, wage documentation, and photographs of the vehicle damage are enclosed. Based on the nature of the injury, the treatment provided, and the impact on her life, our client will accept [DEMAND_AMOUNT] in full settlement of all claims arising from the collision on [LOSS_DATE].

This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a substantive response within that period, we will file suit without further notice to your office.
